snippet.title: Untold Stories 6 - Horrifeye by RenderXR | Minecraft CTM Map Trailer
snippet.description:
Music Used: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SfkD5cADSzg

A shattered realm now void of life and filled with an eerie shadow. All that is left are remnants of a long-forgotten world.
This map features an expansive dark sky world filled with grand areas and brutal design not for the faint-hearted.
furthermore, expect a difficulty that ramps up as natural-spawning monsters scale with the map progress.
The map features a custom soundtrack in the form of music discs made by Crinkles!
Can you survive in this forlorn wasteland or will you perish together with what is left?

MC version 1.14.4 (newest 1.14 release)
Difficulty: Hard, expect a challenge for both new comers to the genre and veterans
Map layout: Open World (with semi-linear layout)
Amount of Monument goals: 12 Ender Eyes (+ 12 Custom Music Discs)

Download it here: https://www.mediafire.com/file/4gh186374a67iz3/
